userRequest: Choose one verification package for incoming GitHub, Stripe, and Standard Webhooks requests.
successConditions: The package verifies each provider's documented signature scheme against the raw request body.
Timestamp or delivery identifier checks prevent replay according to each scheme.

identityFacts: Each webhook endpoint has a separately stored provider secret.
dataFacts: The server retains the raw body bytes until signature verification completes.
operationalFacts: The team wants one maintained verifier rather than three provider-specific packages.

hardConstraints.statement: One candidate must document verification for GitHub, Stripe, and Standard Webhooks signatures.
Verification must expose the timestamp or delivery metadata needed for replay rejection.

preferences.statement: Prefer one typed verification API shared by all three routes.

reasonCodes.description: The request requires one candidate to verify all three supplied schemes.
The candidate documents verification for only its provider or protocol.
The verifier must surface the scheme's replay-protection inputs.

unknowns.description: No candidate evidence establishes ongoing support for all three evolving provider schemes.
